mods.title: VS Hex Mod (V3 / THE EVENT UPDATE)
mods.description: The basketball-loving TV Head returns for a third time! This time, on court! Join Boyfriend and Hex as they get through a sports match for charity, although... who knows, someone might interrupt this festival of joy and hospitality.The Event Update / V3 is available as "Mod Only", "Mobile" , and "Game + Mod" downloads, the contents include:A new story week - "Event X"!7 new freeplay songs + 10 new remixes, including old song versions, thus totaling the unique song count to 30 songs!Lower difficulties available for some songs with modcharts.Base Game / VSlice compatibility, the mod was reworked from the ground up to work on base game engine.New UI for every menu, including Story Mode, Freeplay, Gallery, Jukebox, Options and Credits. The visual, step-by-step tutorials for installing are available above and below.The "Mod Only" download contains the PC version of the mod, without the game. Currently the mod only supports version Preview #4, which needs to be downloaded from the Funkin' Blog post listed below:https://funkin.me/blog/2026-11-14/The "Mobile" download contains the Mobile version of the mod, without the app. Currently the mod only supports version Preview #4, which can be accessed by following steps on Funkin' Blog post listed above.The "Game + Mod" bundle allows you to play the mod now on PC, without additional steps.IMPORTANT: THE MOD SHOULD BE FORWARD COMPATIBLE WITH FUTURE VERSIONS OF V-SLICEANDROID TUTORIAL:iOS TUTORIAL:If you wanna listen to Hexcess, an album consisting of songs from Full Week Update, here they are uploaded onto Spotify and Apple Music!: https://open.spotify.com/album/7ATqQPKkEt6xdPU1uPkJPx?si=6bf9a28a16354774 https://music.apple.com/us/album/hexcess/6818832021If you wanna listen to Hextravaganza, an album consisting of songs from Full Week Update, here they are uploaded onto Spotify, Apple Music and Soundcloud!: https://open.spotify.com/album/3Zb3Hvk89POlwrx8nQLL7ohttps://music.apple.com/us/album/hextravaganza-ep/1563141570https://soundcloud.com/yingyang48/sets/hextravaganzaIf you wanna listen to Hexperience, an album consisting of songs from The Weekend Update and remaining songs from the mod, here they are uploaded onto Spotify and Apple Music!: https://open.spotify.com/album/6m6og2zeiHn7bqFe9SGprqhttps://music.apple.com/us/album/hexperience/1603683226Source code:https://github.com/Kade-github/Hex-V3

mods.title: Taunt! (A V-Slice/Mobile Script)
mods.description: Have You Looked At Literally Fnf (A Roblox Game) And Told Yourself "This Is Great! I Love The Fact That They Added A Button For Just The 'Hey' Animation, But, Would It Be Funny If A Guy With A Studio Made This Dumb Idea For The Real Fnf?" Well, Now Its A Reality!TAUNT! ✌A V-Slice/Mobile Script That Adds A New Function To The Game, The Ability To Taunt! (Or, For New People In The Fnf Community, Do The 'Hey' Animation)Here Is How It Works:PC: When You Press The G Button, It Will Not Only Do The Animation, But Also A Sound! (It Will Sound Different If You Play A Song Where The Playable Character Is Pico)MOBILE: When You Load A Song, It Will Appear A Button On The Bottom-Right Of The Screen (Can Look Different if You Choose A Week 6 Song Or Pico Mixes) If You Press It, It Will Not Only Do The Animation, But Also A Sound! (It Will Sound Different If You Play A Song Where The Playable Character Is Pico)WARNING!! (Stuff That We Added In This Mod)This Mod, Not Only Adds The Ability To Taunt, But Also Adds New Taunt Animations For Car Boyfriend, Pixel Boyfriend, Boyfriend Holding Girlfriend, Pixel Pico And Christmas Pico!But Nonetheless,Hope You Enjoyed This Silly Mod! :DThank You All So Much!! :DTAUNT! + ✌️A V-Slice/Mobile Dlc For "Taunt!" That Adds Custom Playable Characters To The Party!The Mods Compatible With "Taunt! +" Right Now Are:"SONIC JAM!","PTR X FNF (Playable Parappa)","FNF: SPOOKY MIX","FNF: Philly Mix","Sky: REBORN","FNF: Remnants","FNF: Gooey Mix","Girlfriend Mix","FNF 2","The Stick-Mix Collection",And "Playable Tankman".(MORE CUSTOM PLAYABLE CHARACTERS WILL COME IN FUTURE UPDATES OF THE DLC!!)NOTE: You Dont Need All Of The Supported Mods For "Taunt! +" To Work, But You Do Need The Mod Itself For The Dlc To WorkBut Nonetheless,Hope You Enjoyed This Silly Dlc! :D

mods.title: FNF: SONIC JAM!
mods.description: Welcome to SONIC JAMJAMMIN' NEW WEEKTake on the World's Most Famous Hedgehog in WEEK SONIC, a 3-song original level with songs inspired by the rich soundtracks of Sonic CD, Sonic R,Sonic Adventure, and beyond! Revisit a classic locale, experience dazzling hand-drawn cutscenes, and rhyme at super-sonic speeds! Can you keep up?PLAYABLE SONIC CAMPAIGNDr. Eggman's got a new path to world domination-- the POWER of MUSIC! Using his greatest creation, METAL SONIC, the Doctor's taking over the city's musical culture to harness its unlimited musical power. What's worse... is that they're convinced METAL SONIC is the REAL SONIC! But Sonic's not the slacker type. Take back the city's music and clear Sonic's name through intricately crafted 'Sonic Mixes' of FNF's unforgettable soundtrack. With 10+ remixes lovingly created from the ground up, you can check out a fresh, distinct take on Friday Night Funkin's music inspired by New Jack Swing, RNB, 90's House, Rock, Hip Hop, Chiptune, and many more. Face off against the worst of the worst, bring Metal Sonic's reign to an end, and free the spirit of music in Sonic's campaign.GO FOR PERFECTWhen you're playing as Sonic, simply hitting all the notes won't be enough for those brag-worthy P ranks. On top of beating a song flawlessly, you'll need to style on your enemies with a brand new taunt system. After hitting a combo, you'll be able to chain taunts to the rhythm until your next turn. Pull off a sweet chain, and you'll get crazy bonuses that'll shoot you straight to the top! Every SICK note you hit gets added to your SCORE, so be sure to rack up enough for a massive score bonus at the end. Make a name for yourself on the charts as the most stylish MC alive!
